```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version to sync (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        required: true
        type: string
      perform_release:
        required: true
        type: boolean

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    if: ${{ inputs.perform_release == true || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine version
        id: vars
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
          else
            VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
          fi
          # Remove leading 'v' if present for parsing
          CLEAN_VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
          MAJOR_MINOR=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1,2)
          PATCH=$(echo "$CLEAN_VERSION" | cut -d. -f3)
          
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "clean_version=$CLEAN_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "major_minor=$MAJOR_MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "branch_name=docs/v${MAJOR_MINOR}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.branch_name }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          # Check if branch exists
          if git ls-remote --heads origin "$BRANCH_NAME" | grep -q "$BRANCH_NAME"; then
            echo "Branch $BRANCH_NAME exists. Deleting to force push."
            git push origin --delete "$BRANCH_NAME" || true
          fi
          
          # Create branch from tag
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME" "$TAG_NAME"
          
          # Force push the branch
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

      - name: Create Gitbook Variant (if x.y.0 release)
        if: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
          MAJOR_MINOR: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.major_minor }}
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.branch_name }}
        run: |
          VARIANT_NAME="V${MAJOR_MINOR}"
          
          echo "Creating Gitbook variant: $VARIANT_NAME for branch $BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Gitbook API to create a variant
          # Reference: https://docs.gitbook.com/api#variants
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"$VARIANT_NAME\",
              \"branch\": \"$BRANCH_NAME\"
            }"
```
